mapper.select:
SELECT of.id, of.org_code, of.org_name, of.factory_id, of.factory_code, of.factory_name, gi.org_name_path FROM ytsafety_sys_org_factory of LEFT JOIN safety_group_info gi ON gi.code = of.org_code WHERE del_flag = 0
AND of.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orgName}, '%')
AND of.factory_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{factoryName}, '%')
ORDER BY of.update_time DESC
